marketing_description: The Maytag MVWP586GW electric top load washer features a stainless steel drum and offers a range of options with its mechanical knob control and 4 cycles. This model has a capacity of 16 lb and includes features such as an automatic balancing system and end-of-cycle signal. With a durable 3-coat finish and 3.19 cu-ft cylinder volume, this washer is a reliable choice for commercial laundry needs.
